name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for my Craftsman restoration?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for my Craftsman restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor for Craftsman restoration, prepare a general idea of your goals, desired scope of work, and any specific features you want to preserve or restore. Gathering photos of your home, noting its age, and creating a wish list can be very helpful. This initial preparation allows us to better understand your vision and provide a more accurate initial consultation and estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting a contractor, prepare your goals, desired scope, photos of your home, and a wish list to facilitate an accurate consultation.
